INSERT INTO services (instance_id, name, module_name, pid, port, status, updated_at)
             VALUES ($4, $1, 'agent', $2, $3, 'starting', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
             ON CONFLICT (instance_id, name) DO UPDATE SET pid = $2, port = $3, status = 'starting', heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
